_why: The completeness rules exist in two languages: broker/curriculum_quality.py refuses
a publish and fails V11, console/lib/curriculum.ts greys out the Publish button as
somebody types. Two implementations of one rule drift, and the drift is invisible -
the form says a section is fine and the server rejects the save, or worse, the form
says it is a stub and the server accepts it.
So the cases live here and both test suites read this file. A rule added to one side
without the other fails on the side that was not updated.

cases.name: whitespace is missing, not a stub
metasyntactic keys document a shape, not a meaning
short prose is thin, not a stub
a one-step sequence is thin
value: Confirm the grant is assignable before calling the module.

cases.name: real prose is complete
cases.value: Matches a property against the buyer network and returns ranked buyers.

cases.name: named inputs with meanings are complete

value.property_id: The subject property; must already exist in the CRE Forge.
value.max_results: How many ranked buyers to return.

value.silent_partial: A 200 with fewer results than requested.

cases.name: a real sequence is complete
value: Confirm the grant is assignable for this module.
Call the module once with a stable idempotency key.
Escalate rather than repeating on a 4xx.
